Yoga 3.2.1
https://github.com/facebook/yoga (tag v3.2.1)

The core library alone: yoga/ (its CMakeLists.txt and module map dropped)
and LICENSE. Dropped: the Java, JavaScript and Swift bindings, the website,
tests, benchmarks, gentest and the build files of other platforms.
deps/CMakeLists.txt builds yoga/**/*.cpp.
